_doc: The F7 tools (ui/lab_tools.gd, game/lab/lab_recorder.gd, game/lab/resource_watch.gd). views: names of Viewport.DEBUG_DRAW_*, the engine's own debug draws. recorder.settle_ms: the frames after a change left out of its stretch (lab/recorder/analysis.ts SETTLE_MS). resources: window_s the readings kept, least_s before a slope is judged, grow_mib_min and grow_count_min the climb a minute that reads as a leak, best_method the renderer nothing is missing on.
